about: Residuals of the runlink packer against the shipped tables. `gmake check-runlink-tables` fails on any difference or borrowing not listed here and on any listed entry that no longer occurs; regenerate with `gmake runlink-residuals` only to record progress.

bss-size.about: header BSS size without a complete faithful linked source allocation, from the atlas (module)

hybrid-data.about: data-site record in blob-owned data, taken from the shipped table (module, site)

main-placeholder.about: main-table entry whose target the resident source does not name (site, op, type)

placeholder.about: identity of a symbol the source names only by placeholder (module, symbol, sites)

placement.about: object data section placed from the shipped references (module, object, section, offset, evidence)

rodata-base.about: module rodata base the objects do not determine (module)
